verdict.rationale: Ramp documents in-product AI suggestions from customer data: spend requests come with a recommended action based on policies, budgets and funds, and Ramp Intelligence agents scan transactions for anomalies, flag fraud, code expenses and draft memos. However, the documented trend and forecasting insights are delivered through external assistants via Ramp MCP rather than inside the product, and all evidence is vendor marketing. missing for 10: documented in-product analytical insights (spend trends, forecasting, conversational Q&A over data inside the Ramp UI), independent or hands-on corroboration of suggestion quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: All spend requests come with a recommended action grounded in your policies, budgets, and funds, so you can approve or reject in seconds.
Ramp gives you infinite teammates who work around the clock—flagging fraud, coding expenses, and enforcing policy.
Ramp agents scan transactions in real-time for anomalies
As soon as you swipe your card, Ramp captures the receipt and fills in memos and categories.
